name: hud_ui_background_video_widget_set_media_path
description: HudUiBackgroundVideoWidget::SetMediaPathOwnedAndRefresh copies the requested media path, resolves missing files through zSys drive search, clears stream on unresolved media, otherwise allocates and initializes a zFMV_Stream and dispatches RebuildBltRect through the widget ftable.
known_limits: The smoke covers the unresolved-media path that clears stream and preserves the copied media path. The successful stream allocation/initialization path is accepted compositionally from Binary Ninja evidence plus accepted zFMV_Stream::Init and RebuildBltRect/source-vtable evidence.
Reconstructed remains limited because the function carries EH cleanup/codegen debt; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HudUiBackground video-widget pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4bfd40 validates strncpy(mediaPath, path, 0x104), first _stat, zSys::FindFileOnDriveType(5, mediaPath, 0) fallback copy, second _stat clearing stream and returning on failure, operator new for zFMV_Stream, Init(mediaPath, 0), stream assignment, and ftable slot 0x74 RebuildBltRect dispatch.
The native smoke verifies the missing-media path copies the requested path and clears an existing stream pointer.
